Troubleshooting MRP Wizard - Demands for Safety Stock

# Demands Generated by Safety Stock Definitions

 

How demand is handled depends on the part type. 
 
### Type P Parts

 

MRP takes into account the Safety Stock defined for the part in the Purchase/MRP Parameters for Part form ( Planning Quantities tab). 
 
## Tip:

 

To find those parts whose inventory balance is less than their defined safety stock, run the Safety Stock Exceptions report. 
 
### Type R Parts

 

MRP does not generate issues for safety stock. Rather, it is taken into account during purchase planning.
